lifecycle.restore: existing RunPresentationEpoch increment invalidates all pre-restore values, even if persisted Run/Room/Action/Event IDs match; install-gated queries also return false.

lifecycle.new_action_or_weapon: current actual Skill ActionId/InstanceId/ActionStart must match witness, plus actual current action must remain active/locked/ForwardStepIssued.
lifecycle.action_End_or_interrupt: getter rejects !Active, Interrupted or SimulationTime>=A.End. Observer must read each callback during the real active action and preserve its own local copy. End-time lookup cannot manufacture an instant placement proof.
lifecycle.dedupe: Producer is inside the unchanged E.EventId>LastSkillEventId branch after LastSkillEventId=E.EventId; no new IDs or sequences. Getter also checks EventId against real consumed LastSkillEventId and real kernel NextEventId.
lifecycle.observer_stale_key: A successful getter returns latest same-active-action actual fact, not a per-callback new event guarantee. Observer MUST compare Run/Room/Owner/PresentationEpoch/RunRestartSerial/Action/Instance/Event/Subhit/AtTime to its genuine expected event and de-duplicate locally; do not infer zero from lack of audio DTO or getter failure.
lifecycle.no_snapshot_restore: Private latest value is transient; no D13 Owner/World/Run schema or restoration assignments added.
lifecycle.audio_independent: Witness neither requires HeroLocomotionAudioActiveV001 nor calls audio eligibility or Append. Actual audio branch preserved byte-for-byte and remains silent on zero.
